metadata.scenario: A patient calls to reschedule their previously booked knee surgery rehabilitation session. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I need to reschedule my knee surgery rehabilitation session. Hi George! Of course, I can assist you with that. When was your original appointment? It was scheduled for this Thursday at 10 AM, but something came up. No problem at all. What day and time would work better for you? I’m available next Monday or Tuesday morning, if that’s possible. Let me check the schedule for those days. One moment, please. (pause) Okay, I see that we have availability next Monday at 9 AM and Tuesday at 10 AM. Which one would you prefer? Let’s go with Monday at 9 AM, please. Great choice! I’ll go ahead and book that for you. Thank you, I appreciate it. You’re welcome! Is there anything else you’d like to discuss today? Actually, I was wondering about the possibility of adding a personal care assistant for a few hours a week. I can definitely help with that. We offer personal care assistance starting at $28 per hour. That sounds reasonable. What kind of services do they provide? Our personal care assistants help with bathing, dressing, grooming, and other activities of daily living. That would be really helpful. How do I get started with that? I can set up a consultation to discuss your needs further. Yes, please. Let’s do that. Perfect! I’ll have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, reach out to you. Sounds good. What’s her contact information? Lisa Chen can be reached at +13165559203. Thank you! I’ll look out for her call. You’re welcome, George. I’ve booked your rehab session for Monday at 9 AM. I appreciate your help, Margaret. Anytime, George! Have a great day and take care! You too, bye! Goodbye!
